BiblicalUsage: Jaziz the Hagerite was over the flocks of King David, one of the rulers of the substance that was the king's. He stands in the list of the officers who kept David's herds and camels and asses.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts the keepers of flocks among the rulers of the kingdom, and Jaziz is remembered for faithful work.
